Interface RegistrationJob

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
public interface RegistrationJob extends AutoCloseable
Tracks one molecule registration update and lets its caller remove the set installed by that update later.

Keep the job returned by MoleculeRegistration.submit(boolean, java.util.function.Consumer) to check progress, observe success or failure, or request cleanup when your feature is disabled. Cancellation can prevent queued work; it cannot interrupt changes that are already being applied or undo a successful update.

After success, the job retains the exact view produced by its update. Releasing it removes the resulting complete registration set only if that same set is still current. An old job cannot remove a newer replacement. Observe the separate release result as cleanup can be rejected when other definitions still depend on this set.

    • onComplete

      void onComplete(Consumer<RegistrationJob> listener)
      Registers one observer, including after completion. Each registration runs once; listener errors cannot change publication outcome. It runs on the completing thread, or the registering thread if late. Client UI work must be scheduled onto the client thread explicitly.
      Parameters:
      listener - outcome observer

    • release

      CompletionStage<MoleculeView> release()
      Releases the resulting owner layer only while this exact generation is still current. Cancels pending work first. A release after supersession is a successful no-op. A rejected release leaves the layer valid and may be retried after its dependencies change.
      Returns:
      asynchronous cleanup result; observe failures without blocking a game thread

    • released

      boolean released()
      Tests whether ownership-specific cleanup completed successfully.
      Returns:
      whether a release completed successfully, including a superseded no-op
